channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open with mild gains amid intense AI discussions
item.description: The Indian equity markets traded in green with mild positive bias early on Thursday, extending the steady multi-session recovery seen in the last three days, as the 'India AI Impact Summit 2026' continues in New Delhi with intense discussions around AI.

item.title: Kolkata Police arrest one from Haryana for online fraud
item.description: After that, the police searched based on the IP address of that app. The name of 29-year-old Deepak came up from that source. After that, a notice was sent to him. His mobile and SIM were confiscated.

item.title: Yogi Babu-starrer Kenatha Kanom’s first look released
item.description: Actor Arya on Thursday released the first look of late Director Suresh Sangaiah’s upcoming film 'Kenatha Kanom', featuring actor Yogi Babu in the lead, much to the delight of fans and film buffs.

item.title: Bengal SIR: 20 lakh voters’ documents pending re-verification by DEOs
item.description: With just three days left for the deadline for scrutiny of voters' documents submitted during the hearing sessions on claims and objections on the draft voters' list to expire, around 20 lakh voters' documents are pending re-verification from the side of the District Magistrates, who are also the District Eelectoral Officers (DEOs).

item.title: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation launches app to streamline civic services
item.description: The Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) has launched MyCUREApp, an upgraded and integrated digital platform aimed at streamlining civic services and accelerating grievance redressal across the city.

item.title: RCOM loan fraud: Anil Ambani files affidavit in Supreme Court; reiterates not to leave country
item.description: Industrialist Anil D. Ambani has filed an undertaking/compliance affidavit before the Supreme Court reiterating that he will not leave the country without prior permission of the apex court in connection with the ongoing probe into alleged large-scale bank loan frauds linked to Reliance Communications Ltd (RCOM) and its group entities.

item.title: New Zealand batter Lauren Down announces retirement
item.description: New Zealand batter Lauren Down has called time on her 15-year cricket career at the age of 30. She played 35 ODIs and 13 T20Is for the White Ferns since her international debut in 2018.

item.title: Nearly a dozen Noida schools get bomb threats amid ongoing CBSE exams
item.description: Nearly a dozen schools in Noida received bomb threat emails on Thursday, sparking panic among students, parents and school staff, even as the CBSE Board examinations entered their third day.

item.title: No stampede at Shivneri Fort, says Pune SP; Shivjayanti celebrated with grandeur
item.description: Pune Superintendent of Police (SP) Sandeep Singh Gill on Thursday denied reports of stampede at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's birthplace, Shivneri Fort.

item.title: Varanasi court to hear review plea against Rahul Gandhi today
item.description: According to the complaint, he had questioned whether Sikhs in India would be permitted to wear turbans and kadas and whether he would be able to visit gurdwaras as a Sikh.
